extraction: DMux workflow patterns: (1) Sequential pipeline — agents in series, pane passes context. (2) Parallel fan-out — one agent spawns N workers in N panes. (3) Fan-in — N workers merge to one aggregator pane. Maps to our flow: Sequential = Engine→Verdict→Miss per engine. Fan-out = Engine builds 3 engines in 3 panes. Fan-in = Verdict aggregates 3 CER reports. We use all three patterns simultaneously.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether dmux patterns cover all our coordination needs (sequential per engine, parallel across engines)
